summary: All 7 UI change items verified PASS on Expo web preview at 390x844. Onboarding jumps straight to topics (no intro/profile/format/dots), Home has new compact counter pill in header (~58px), old bottom badge removed, story cards restored to full width (~337.7px ≈ 86.6% of 390), Explore renders 4 tiles/row and fits without scroll, reader chapter cards + eyebrows share one uniform tint across chapters for both spazio and scienza (both map to #3FE0FF), counter dynamically increases after POST /api/user/complete, and Profile/Saved/Stats screens load without errors.

react_native_issues.issue: Console: '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow".' Emitted in multiple places (onboarding topic-picker.tsx title, story-palette-derived styles). Not a regression, just deprecation warnings.
Console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (home-story-card scrims, topic-picker backdrop, etc.). Not blocking.
'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' (Saved screen). Not blocking.

action_items: Optional cleanup: migrate textShadow* -> textShadow shorthand and props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents across scrim/backdrop components to silence RN 0.76+ deprecation warnings (non-blocking).
